name: Voice Conversion Challenge 2016
description: Evaluation results for systems submitted to the Voice Conversion Challenge 2016, which measures voice conversion quality and similarity.
typical_sota_score: MOS ≈ 3.5–4.2 (out of 5) for naturalness; similarity judgments ≈ 60–80% for top systems (varies by task and evaluation protocol)
notes: Human-listening evaluation benchmark; scores are not directly comparable across studies and the challenge is relatively old.
